title: Chapter 410: Fighting For The Magic Core
content:
Chapter 410: Fighting For The Magic Core

The two looked at each other and immediately flew to the battlefield.

The shirtless man looked in the direction of Wang Shuo and said in a low voice: "Wu Jie, why don't we defeat this group of people first and then fight.

The other man Wu Jie replied indifferently.

"Okay."

But neither of them stopped moving forward. One of them attacked the snow monster with a sword and the other with a knife, and reached out to grab the magic core of the snow leopard.

"Didn't we agree to stop the other group first?"

"Chen Chen, didn't you stop either?"

The two stared at each other resentfully, but did not fight.

At this time, Wang Shuo and Zhu Dongheng rushed to the battlefield, and the rest of the people also surrounded the snow monster, Wu Jie and Chen Chen.

"Look, you two, you are now surrounded. Why don't you retreat here to avoid unnecessary fighting? What do you think?"

"Boy, do you think you have already won? "

Wu Jie and Chen Chen, forced by the situation, had to join forces to fight the enemy.

They had conflicts in the beginning and fought several times in the snowy mountains, but they were unable to do anything to each other.

"What nonsense, fight if you want!"

Wang Shuo looked at the shouting Wu Jie and immediately performed the "Iron Chain Binding".

But something surprised Wang Shuo.

This control skill was not successfully launched.

At this time, Wu Jie's eyes were fierce, holding the knife with both hands, and a move of "Strike Huashan" was used to chop towards Wang Shuo's head.

Wang Shuo was not too panicked. He raised his gun to block the opponent's attack, raised his hands and kicked out.

The imagined situation of flying backwards did not happen.

Wang Shuo's kick seemed to hit a steel plate, and the opponent just took a slight step back.

This...

It seems that the opponent is also of the type of Gong Zheng, with defense The force is amazing, but the attack power is not strong. After all, Wang Shuo easily caught the knife just now.

On Zhu Dongheng's side, he directly summoned 4 puppets.

Zhu Dongheng is a puppeteer who is good at making puppets. At the same time, his own attack and defense are also good. The intermediate general named Chen Chen seemed to be surrounded and beaten by several intermediate generals.

However, the attack of the puppet is not sharp. Although it has the strength of an intermediate general, it is the weakest intermediate general.

One of the reasons why Zhu Dongheng readily agreed to come here with Wang Shuo is to collect materials. After all, the more materials are used to make puppets, the more The better, the stronger the attack power.

On the other side, Xie Xiaofeng, Ba Huoyao, Ayub and others were dealing with the injured snow monster.

The snow monster was seriously injured and was besieged by everyone. It was impossible to take care of both ends. It was only a matter of time to kill the snow monster.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but sigh at this time, there is still strength in numbers.

Fighting alone is always the worst strategy.

Seeing that the situation was very good, Wang Shuo was no longer distracted and fought seriously.

He also wanted to practice with this opponent.

See how big the gap is between himself and other masters.

Wang Shuo used his internal force and poured it into the Overlord Spear. He used a move of "Flying Dragon in the Sky", and the dragon shadow Soaring in the sky, it quickly pounced on Wu Jie.

Wu Jie had originally looked down on Wang Shuo, thinking that he was a bit fancy, but when the dragon shadow pounced on him, he felt a huge force, like a tidal wave, attacking him.

He was shocked and tried his best to resist, barely resisting this attack.

Unexpectedly, Wang Shuo's second move followed.

He had to defend with all his strength.

Wang Shuo's moves were very coherent, one after another.

Wu Jie could only passively defend, feeling miserable.

Although Wang Shuo had gained an advantage, he had already used several big moves and still could not break Wu Jie's defense.
